publicationRule: Publish only exact reviewed v2 WebP with correct Centaurea jacea identity, credited photo fallback, and both green illustration-contract and approved-flora-browser jobs. Preserve 23 prior approvals.

items.name: Engknoppurt
items.observations: The corrected v2 depicts branched upright flowering stems, narrow alternating upper leaves and broader basally clustered oblong leaves, lavender-magenta tubular florets in composite heads, and rounded broad tan-to-dark-brown papery involucral bract appendages with irregularly torn edges (rather than the spiny tips rejected in v1). Root crown and fibrous roots represented for the field-guide study.
items.limitations: The magnification of the overlapping papery bract appendages, the uniform tubular florets and the exact arrangement of basal leaves and root crown are artistic reconstructions rather than a taxonomic plate from a preserved specimen. The image is a visual aid for general recognition, not evidence sufficient for species-level identification; use the documented photograph to compare regional variants and close knapweed relatives.
items.technicalVerification: Original generated RGBA source 1024x1536 converted directly to VP8X WebP with intact genuine alpha; 420680 bytes; exact SHA-256 and Git blob SHA computed from binary; rendered against dark and light backgrounds without checkerboard artifacts; Git blob verified after transfer.

rejectedPreviousCandidate.limitations: The brown capitulum involucral appendages are rendered too pointed and spine-like; Centaurea jacea typically shows broad, overlapping, brown, papery, irregularly lacerate appendages. The flower heads and lower leaf outlines are stylized. The generated image originally had an opaque grey checkerboard background; alpha was derived by chroma extraction and can leave edge artifacts. It must not be promoted as a botanically approved field guide image until redrawn and rechecked.
